name: ctl-a
launch: python3 -c 'import os,sys; os.setsid(); os.execvp(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[1:])' mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B-4bit --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 > server.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
stop: p=$(lsof -nP -iTCP:8080 -sTCP:LISTEN -t) || exit 0; kill $p; for i in $(seq 60); do kill -0 $p 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sleep 1; done; kill -9 $p
